definitions.explanation: A complete change from one state to the opposite; positions or situations being reversed.
Coming from behind to take the lead in a game, match, or contest.

examples.japanese: ⟦{立場|たちば}→立場：03403_tachiba⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{逆転|ぎゃくてん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{形勢|けいせい}→形勢：16342_keisei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{逆転|ぎゃくてん}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{劣勢|れっせい}→劣勢：08647_ressei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The situation reversed and we fell behind.

examples.japanese: 9⟦{回|かい}→回：00957_kai⟧⟦{裏|うら}→裏：02178_ura⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{逆転|ぎゃくてん}⟦ホームラン→ホームラン：20814_hoomuran⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{打|う}った→打つ：01221_utsu⟧。
examples.english: He hit a come-from-behind home run in the bottom of the ninth.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大逆転|だいぎゃくてん}→大逆転：21652_daigyakuten⟧⟦{勝利|しょうり}→勝利：11795_shouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{収|おさ}めた→収める：02022_osameru⟧。
examples.english: They achieved a stunning comeback victory.

notes:
{逆転|ぎゃくてん} describes a reversal of positions or situations.

ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{逆|ぎゃく}→逆：02649_gyaku⟧ (reverse, opposite) + {転|てん} (turn) - turning to the opposite.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {逆転|ぎゃくてん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ - to reverse, to make a comeback
- {逆転|ぎゃくてん}⟦{勝利|しょうり}→勝利：11795_shouri⟧ - comeback victory
- {逆転|ぎゃくてん}⟦ホームラン→ホームラン：20814_hoomuran⟧ - come-from-behind home run
- ⟦{大逆転|だいぎゃくてん}→大逆転：21652_daigyakuten⟧ - major turnaround
- ⟦{形勢|けいせい}→形勢：16342_keisei⟧{逆転|ぎゃくてん} - tables turned

USAGE:
Very common in sports commentary, especially baseball. Also used in business, politics, and everyday situations where positions or advantages change.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {逆転|ぎゃくてん} vs. ⟦{転換|てんかん}→転換：19439_tenkan⟧: {逆転|ぎゃくてん} implies reversal to the opposite; ⟦{転換|てんかん}→転換：19439_tenkan⟧ is a change or shift in direction, not necessarily to the opposite
- {逆転|ぎゃくてん} vs. カムバック: Similar in sports contexts; カムバック is the loanword
